resources.string: Raahi is an offline-first road-trip and journey companion for India.
No browser is available to open this link.

Your location stays on your device. There is no account and no sign-in. Raahi uses Mapbox to show maps and plan routes, and Mapbox may collect anonymous usage telemetry as described in its privacy policy.
Raahi is built with open-source software including AndroidX, Jetpack Compose, Kotlin, Retrofit, OkHttp and the Mapbox Maps SDK. Their licences apply to their own code.
Search and routing need an internet connection, and navigation works only while the app is open. Offline mode covers map viewing in downloaded areas, saved places, trips and emergency information.
